scope: Native CLI reimport of the exact accepted K03.var01 exclamation-delimited text export at width 4096, followed by JSON export, calculation and report if conversion succeeds.

manual.rule: Native -timport accepts a text file using the same delimiter and width as export; text exchange may lose accuracy.

acceptance_hypotheses: Native -timport/-save produces a nonempty SXI and -jexport returns all authored K02 model rows, keys and instances, apart from the already-observed DTIM precision loss 0.3333333333333333 to 0.3 and documented native empty-default canonicalization.
Native calculation has zero converter errors and a usable SXO, first-repetition ENLOG and JSON report.
The mission event log and non-description report data equal the accepted K02 parent despite the text precision loss in unused scheduled DTIM.
gate: Missing/altered authored rows or keys, unclassified extra numeric loss, converter rejection, unusable SXO or changed mission/report is NO-GO for this roundtrip hypothesis. A rejected run is preserved as a diagnostic without asserting general text-import behavior.
limitations: One delimiter, width and model; fixed-width text is K03.var02 and is not tested here. Clipboard, Excel XML, GUI import and general numeric fidelity remain unverified.
